captions.detailed: This 3D model features a dark, four-post welded steel tower structure supporting a bell. The tower is built on a square baseplate, with four upright vertical posts reinforced by cross-braced diagonal tension rods on all four sides. At the top of the tower, a horizontal crossbeam assembly holds a black pivot yoke. Suspended from this yoke is a classic, conical bell colored in a contrasting orange-bronze hue. The bell assembly is designed to swing freely on a horizontal axis.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a four-post welded steel bell tower on a square baseplate. The tower frame must be dark gray/black with diagonal cross-braces on each side, a top rectangular frame, and a central crossbeam. Hang a contrasting orange-bronze conical bell from a central pivot yoke attached to the top crossbeam, allowing it to swing on a horizontal axis.
captions.factory: The model is built using an assembly system of parts. First, a base plate is defined as a thin box. Four vertical posts are created using cylinders positioned at the corners. The top frame is constructed using four box sections configured in a square, with an additional box section spanning the middle as the crossbeam. Diagonal cross-braces are added as thin cylinders angled across each face. The bell is modeled as a truncated cone (or combined cylinders/cones) with an orange-bronze material, suspended from a U-shaped yoke. A revolute joint is established between the top crossbeam and the yoke to allow the bell to swing.
